BeforeExpression: VAR CurrentCategory = SELECTEDVALUE(DimProduct[CategoryLabel]) VAR Candidates = FILTER(ADDCOLUMNS(ALLSELECTED(DimProduct[CategoryLabel]), "__PeriodRevenue", CALCULATE([Sales Revenue], ALLSELECTED(DimDate[YearMonth]))), NOT ISBLANK([__PeriodRevenue])) VAR Winners = TOPN(5, Candidates, [__PeriodRevenue], DESC, DimProduct[CategoryLabel], ASC) RETURN IF(NOT ISBLANK(CurrentCategory) && CONTAINS(Winners, DimProduct[CategoryLabel], CurrentCategory), 1, 0)
AfterExpression: VAR CurrentCategory = SELECTEDVALUE(DimProduct[CategoryLabel]) VAR Candidates = FILTER(ADDCOLUMNS(ALLSELECTED(DimProduct[CategoryLabel]), "__PeriodRevenue", CALCULATE([Sales Revenue], ALLSELECTED(DimDate[YearMonth], DimDate[MonthStartDate]))), NOT ISBLANK([__PeriodRevenue])) VAR Winners = TOPN(5, Candidates, [__PeriodRevenue], DESC, DimProduct[CategoryLabel], ASC) RETURN IF(NOT ISBLANK(CurrentCategory) && CONTAINS(Winners, DimProduct[CategoryLabel], CurrentCategory), 1, 0)
